### David’s Last Words
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/davids-last-words
Passage: 2 Samuel 23:1-7
Points:
- David’s final public words were an inspired prophetic oracle given through the Holy Spirit.
- A leader who governs justly in the fear of God brings life like morning sun and rain.
- Since no earthly king reigns with perfect justice, these verses point to the Messiah.
- The eternal kingdom of Jesus Christ brings true, lasting life to the world.
- Reflecting on Christ’s coming kingdom grounds our expectations and motivates daily faithfulness.

### The Blessing of (Good) Authority
Author: Jonathan Leeman
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/king-david-final-words-godly-authority-2-samuel-23/
Passage: 2 Samuel 23:3-4
Points:
- Fallen human nature frequently abuses power, making people cynical and fearful toward authority.
- God designed authority not to oppress, but to author, protect, and create.
- David’s poem pictures just, God-fearing leadership as a clear dawn and rain nourishing grass.
- Christ fulfills David's portrait by using His perfect authority for the flourishing of His people.
- Christian leaders should mirror Christ by using their influence to build up others.
